summary.text: David Suetterlein is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 4.
The Senate biography lists David Suetterlein's service in the Senate since 2016.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, David Suetterlein was born on January 4, 1985.
David Suetterlein studied at Grove City College (B.A.).
David Suetterlein's listed memberships and affiliations include the Roanoke County Republican Party (chair, 2012-2016; secretary, 2008-2012).
The biography lists Ashley Suetterlein as David Suetterlein's spouse.
The Senate page lists David Suetterlein's committee assignments as Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources, Education and Health, Transportation, and Rules.
